##### Project general facts

Odessa by Nshama Group is a contemporary residential development in Town Square Dubai, offering a collection of elegantly designed one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments. Ideally positioned near the main park, the project combines boulevard views, green surroundings, and modern architecture to create a balanced lifestyle where tranquility and urban convenience go hand in hand. Bright interiors, sleek layouts, porcelain flooring, and thoughtfully designed kitchens reflect a refined approach to contemporary living, tailored to both comfort and functionality.

Residents enjoy a wide range of lifestyle amenities designed to support recreation, wellness, and social interaction. The development features swimming pools, fully equipped gyms, indoor and outdoor children’s play areas, BBQ zones, and multipurpose rooms for gatherings and leisure. With direct access to the main park, residents can also enjoy jogging and cycling trails, open green spaces, and a peaceful outdoor environment that enhances everyday life within the wider Town Square community.

Each residence is finished with high-quality modern materials that emphasize durability and style throughout the interiors. The apartments include fully equipped kitchens fitted with German-made appliances and are delivered unfurnished, giving homeowners the flexibility to personalize their living spaces while enjoying a well-appointed contemporary home.

##### Location description and benefits

Town Square Dubai is a vibrant and expansive mega-development located in the heart of Dubai. At the core of Town Square Dubai is the picturesque Town Square Park, which serves as the central hub for residents and visitors alike. The park features lush green spaces, jogging tracks, and play areas, providing a refreshing escape from the urban hustle and creating a sense of unity and community spirit.

Town Square Dubai boasts a host of exceptional facilities and amenities, making it a vibrant and dynamic place to live. Residents can enjoy access to sports courts, fitness centers, swimming pools, as well as retail and dining outlets within the community. A Town Square Mall, with a variety of shops and entertainment options, further enriches the living experience.

The development's strategic location provides easy connectivity to major highways, ensuring convenient access to other parts of Dubai. Additionally, Town Square Dubai is within proximity to schools, hospitals, and other essential services, offering residents a well-connected and comprehensive lifestyle.
